P.h: Tensorlake npm worm wipes your home directory if you revoke its stolen token
P.p: tensorlake@0.5.144 steals developer credentials at install and plants a gh-token-monitor service. If the stolen GitHub token is revoked, the service wipes the home directory. The release came from malicious commits pushed to main under a maintainer's name, so it carries a valid npm provenance attestation.
P.s: Pin to 0.5.143 and remove the service under ~/.config/gh-token-monitor/ before revoking any token. Then rotate every credential the machine held. StepSecurity found the worm spreading through victims' packages and repos.

It raises per-file delete decisions, caps Slack posts at three per ten minutes, and injects secrets at an egress gateway so agents never see them.
P.s: Microsoft made Execution Containers generally available on Windows, with local model support through Windows ML and llama.cpp. GitHub Copilot gets sandboxed tool execution on top.
